title: Postdoctoral Position in Theory, Particle and Nuclear Division
institution: Tsung-Dao Lee Institute (TDLI), Shanghai Jiao Tong University
about: The Tsung-Dao Lee Institute in Shanghai invites applications for theory postdocs in its Particle and Nuclear Division, starting from fall 2027. Applications go through AcademicJobsOnline with at least three reference letters; the deadline is 20 December 2026.
